description: Approved differences between the legacy goldens and the NEW ConsultarEstadoModulo. Goldens are never edited; compare_new.py applies these entries only to its own verdict.

approved.approval: DEV-A3 (plan section 9, approved by the user); Q-ESM-6
approved.reason: The golden pins the legacy exception text '<driver message> Query: <SQL> Parameters: [{IdEmpresa=1}]' (cl.bcs.utils.SQL.rethrow). The new service must not leak SQL or parameters: the HTTP layer answers a generic 500 with a correlationId and the raw exception text never leaves the service. The driver text is also H2/HANA specific.
approved.mask: Only the value of 'excepcion' is masked. Everything else (decisionServlet = ROLLBACK_HTTP500, tablas, colaboradores, secuenciasSolicitadas, absence of 'salida') must still be identical to the golden.
